claim: Solver-independent canonical state has precedent
v2_action: Shared/private state replaces universal-state sufficiency.

claim: Discrete cells plus continuum fields is established
v2_action: Hybrid cell/field model retained as planned biological structure, not implemented 3D environment.

claim: Multirate scheduling is appropriate
v2_action: Explicit window/subcycling reference; no general multirate accuracy claim.

claim: preCICE makes selected packages readily integrable
v2_action: Offline adapters first; live preCICE integration remains a build task.

claim: SOFA and ESPResSo are high-fidelity biological oracles
v2_action: Oracle terminology removed; each comparator requires matched model and convergence.

claim: Tissue Forge offers an independent reference
v2_action: Tissue Forge remains a candidate comparator, not an executed independent reference.

claim: 932/1055 BioModels matched across at least two engines
v2_action: ODE cross-engine result preserved at its original scope; not extrapolated to spatial physics.

claim: FDA/ASME credibility methods directly justify the proposed ML/fidelity layer
v2_action: No regulatory approval or ML qualification inferred.

claim: Surrogate distillation is feasible
v2_action: Surrogate feasibility is a later experiment; no model trained.

claim: Mean discrepancy plus lambda uncertainty gives a guarantee
v2_action: Error-plus-uncertainty guarantee withdrawn; empirical/coverage requirements specified.

claim: Regional multi-fidelity cellular simulation is novel
v2_action: No novelty claim; dedicated prior-art and implementation evaluation required.

claim: Four-population vascularized spheroids demonstrate functional spheroid perfusion
v2_action: Spheroid morphology and in-vivo perfusion remain distinct measurements.

claim: Vascularized-organoid paper validates tumor therapy
v2_action: Non-cancer organoid platform is vascular-engineering precedent only.

claim: Renal tumor chip supplies useful component data
v2_action: Renal chip target restricted to measured tracer/bead/vascular endpoints.

claim: The ABC paper provides broad evidence for tumor-model calibration
v2_action: ABC example kept conditional on its model/data and identity caveats.

claim: SBML/SED-ML/OMEX fully specify the proposed world
v2_action: Custom ZIP is not OMEX; standard support requires actual feature/round-trip tests.

claim: Warp is the best or biologically credible production backend
v2_action: Warp optional; no selection as fastest or biologically preferred.

claim: The packaged example realizes the proposed vascularized microtumor experiment
v2_action: Example renamed synthetic bookkeeping; microtumor is nonrunnable proposal.

claim: The four passing tests establish scaffold correctness beyond smoke testing
v2_action: Selected regression and numerical evidence reported with explicit limits.

claim: Total error is a simple sum of independent uncertainties
v2_action: Error categories distinguished; no unjustified independence assumption.

claim: Local solver escalation ensures global trajectory accuracy
v2_action: Conditional accumulation bound and switching errors stated; no runtime guarantee.

claim: Increasing detail monotonically improves biological realism
v2_action: Observable-specific model portfolio replaces monotonic realism ladder.

claim: Arbitrary external entities can be physically predicted
v2_action: Externals require typed inputs and justified response laws.

claim: A validated constitutive law transfers across cell populations
v2_action: Cell identity, calibration and applicability required before population transfer.

claim: Detailed mechanics and nuclear deformation have experimental relevance
v2_action: Mechanics evidence motivates scoped later experiments, not blanket detailed modeling.

claim: Mechanical strain can be converted to universal rupture or mutation thresholds
v2_action: Universal strain/rupture thresholds removed; biological threshold fields remain unset.
